result.markdown:
# Transport Degradation on Microwave Link LNK-TUN-02-A impacting S-TUN-009

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-TUN-02-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of a major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-TUN-02-A precisely matching the onset of latency increase and traffic impact at S-TUN-009. Maintenance, changes, and external events during the window were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-20 04:30 to 2026-09-20 06:12
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-20 04:27
- **Affected:** S-TUN-009, S-TUN-004, S-TUN-015

## Summary

Major link degradation on microwave link LNK-TUN-02-A resulting in increased latency and reduced traffic capacity at site S-TUN-009.

Traffic was down and latency was up at site S-TUN-009 due to microwave link degradation starting at 2026-09-20 04:30 and recovering when the alarm cleared at 2026-09-20 06:12.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-20 04:27: Major LINK_DEGRADED alarm raised on microwave link LNK-TUN-02-A [ALM-000414]
- 2026-09-20 04:30: Latency increase and traffic impact observed at S-TUN-009 [T3, ALR-0030, ANM-000234]
- 2026-09-20 06:12: LINK_DEGRADED alarm cleared on LNK-TUN-02-A and metrics recovered [ALM-000414]

## Evidence

- A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm occurred on microwave link LNK-TUN-02-A from 2026-09-20 04:27 to 2026-09-20 06:12. [T4, ALM-000414]
- Site S-TUN-009 experienced a latency_ms deviation above baseline starting at 2026-09-20 04:30. [T3, ANM-000234]
- No maintenance windows or configuration changes were scheduled or executed on S-TUN-009, LNK-TUN-02-A, or AGG-TUN-02 during the incident window. [T5, T6]
- S-TUN-009 depends on LNK-TUN-02-A in the network topology. [T2]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-02-A: confirmed. Direct major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on the feeding microwave link perfectly correlated in time with the site performance degradation. [ALM-000414, T3]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected nodes during the time window. [T6]

## Ruled out

- EVT-002: Stadium event ended hours before the incident and occurred near a different site (S-TUN-001).
- ALM-000410: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-TUN-015 occurred hours earlier and resolved well before the incident.
- ALM-000411: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-TUN-015 occurred hours earlier and resolved well before the incident.
- ALM-000412: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-TUN-015 occurred hours earlier and resolved well before the incident.
- ALM-000413: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-TUN-015 occurred hours earlier and resolved well before the incident.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor microwave link LNK-TUN-02-A for weather conditions (rain fade) or hardware health.
